verdict.rationale: No evidence describes scoped, permissioned access for external third parties (law firms, HRIS vendors, wealth managers) to limited slices of cap table data; documentation covers admin dashboards, cap table management, fundraising, and transfer agent functions but not third-party scoped access controls. Missing for 10: any mention of role-based/scoped external access, third-party integration permissions, or delegated credential-free access for outside parties.
